from graphene import Schema
from graphql import parse, specified_rules, validate
from depth_rules import depth_limit_validator
from schema_types import Query

schema = Schema(query=Query)


def execute_document(document_text):
    parsed_document = parse(document_text)
    errors = validate(
        schema.graphql_schema,
        parsed_document,
        rules=specified_rules + (depth_limit_validator(10),),
    )
    if errors:
        raise ValueError("; ".join(error.message for error in errors))
    return schema.execute(document_text)

from graphql_cases.base_views import BaseGraphQLView
from graphql.validation import NoSchemaIntrospectionCustomRule


class DerivedGraphQLView(BaseGraphQLView):
    pass


class IntrospectionMiddleware:
    pass


class ConfiguredGraphQLView(BaseGraphQLView):
    middleware = [IntrospectionMiddleware]
    validation_rules = (NoSchemaIntrospectionCustomRule,)


DerivedGraphQLView.as_view(schema=schema)
ConfiguredGraphQLView.as_view(schema=schema)
ConfiguredGraphQLView.as_view(schema=schema, middleware=[])
